wall.title: Library
wall.emptyHint: Ask Reelix for something to watch, or find a title by hand.
wall.untracked_one: {{count}} folder in the library that Reelix does not track
wall.untracked_other: {{count}} folders in the library that Reelix does not track
wall.askAdopt: Ask the agent to adopt them
wall.askAdoptPrompt_one: There is {{count}} untracked folder in the library ({{examples}}). Please identify and adopt it.
wall.askAdoptPrompt_other: There are {{count}} untracked folders in the library (for example {{examples}}). Please identify and adopt them.

title.fixMatchPrompt: {{desc}} looks matched to the wrong title. Please check and fix the match:
title.noNotes: No notes. Notes are lasting corrections the agent reads, e.g. “episode 13 is S2E1”.
title.libraryFolderUndecided: No rule decides this title. When it is downloaded, the assistant compares it with what each folder holds and asks you if it is not sure. You can choose here.

libraryFolderHow.only: The only folder for this type.
libraryFolderHow.default: No rule decides; this is the default folder.
libraryFolderHow.there: The title is already in this folder.

remove.title: Remove {{title}}?
remove.descWhole: Choose how far to go for the whole title.
remove.descSeason: Choose how far to go for season {{season}}.
remove.descEpisodes: Choose how far to go for season {{season}}, episodes {{episodes}}.
remove.episodesInvalid: Episodes: use numbers and ranges like 1,2,5-7.

entry.label: Remove from the library only
entry.detail: Unlinks the library files. The download stays, so this can be restored.

torrent.label: Also remove the torrent
torrent.detail: Unlinks the files and removes the torrent from the downloader. The downloaded data stays on disk.

data.label: Also delete the downloaded data
data.detail: Removes everything. Data only in the download folder is gone at once; a last remaining copy goes to the trash for a while.

adopt.title: Adopt existing downloads
adopt.subtitle: Torrents already in the downloader, matched and planned. Nothing is linked until you approve.
adopt.scanHint: Scan the downloader for torrents Reelix does not track yet. It can take a while for a large client.
adopt.summary: {{confident}} confident (ticked), {{uncertain}} uncertain, {{applied}} applied. Uncertain rows need a title before they can be ticked.
adopt.titleIdPlaceholder: Title id, e.g. tv:1399 or movie:603
